ideas_being_explored.what_is_different_now: Pricing alternatives now expose the cheaper hardware-boundary package and explicit defer options for wireless and firmware, so the cost-sensitive prototype path is no longer just an implicit compromise.
main_risks: Deferring quality-upgrade packages may underbuild wireless or firmware trust margin.
